nodes.concept_name: Domain of Rationality & Capital Management Invariance
nodes.detailed_description: Foundational axiom proved via 200 coin tosses (101/99) and 32 live random Google RNG trades: fixed 0.5%-2.0% risk per trade (max 10% total) with immutable SL/TP makes account ruin (margin call) mathematically impossible.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Enforce Risk_Pct in [0.5%, 2.0%], Total_Risk_Pct <= 10.0%, and Allow_SL_Widening = False.

nodes.concept_name: Psychological Risk Tolerance Ceiling & Transactional Analysis
nodes.detailed_description: Dollar risk per trade must remain below the trader's endocrine stress threshold (starting at $0.05-$0.10 on real accounts and using 0.5%-1.0% Set-and-Forget to neutralize pre-age-5 revenge-trading scripts).
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Cap Risk_USD <= Comfort_Ceiling_USD; trigger Emotional Circuit Breaker when external stress occurs.

nodes.concept_name: Trading Horizon Separation & Temporal Stop-Loss (EOD Close)
nodes.detailed_description: Strict separation of Day Trader (<24h), Multi-Day Trader (>24h leveraged), and Investor (unleveraged). 90% of margin calls stem from removing SL on a day trade to hold overnight ('buying hope'). Enforces mandatory EOD closure at NY Close.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Auto-close all Day Trader positions at 22:58 (US30) / 23:55 (XAUUSD/FX) GMT+3.

nodes.concept_name: Market Cycle Candle-by-Candle Counting & P-Gap Validation
nodes.detailed_description: Reading price bar-by-bar inside Market Cycles (Spike, Channel, Range) and validating Spikes strictly by the presence of a non-overlapping Price Gap (P-Gap: L[i+1] > H[i-1] bullish or H[i+1] < L[i-1] bearish).
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Reject any candidate Spike where max(L[i+1]-H[i-1]) <= 0 (bullish) or max(L[i-1]-H[i+1]) <= 0 (bearish).

nodes.detailed_description: Foundational Spike-Cycle setup hunting the 2nd Leg after the first candle sweeps the prior candle's Low (uptrend) or High (downtrend), with SL behind Spike origin, 1:1/1:2 TP, and optional 50% SL-distance supplementary scale-in.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Implement SP2LStrategyEngine with primary entry, origin SL, 1:1/1:2 TP, and 50% scale-in limit.

nodes.concept_name: PRO BTB Strategy (Professional Back To Breakeven)
nodes.detailed_description: Professional retest strategy entering when price breaks a key level and returns to the Breakout Candle Close (Breakeven) or Broken Level via 6 standard entry modes and 3 SL anchor modes for >= 1:2 R/R.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Implement ProBTBStrategyEngine supporting Modes 1..6 and 3 SL anchor modes.

nodes.detailed_description: Legend-tier Spike strategy trailing stop orders down a counter-trend micro-channel (Entry 1, Entry 2, Entry 3) or Inside Bar pause, plus H2 (Opt 1) and H3 (Opt 2) confirmation entries, achieving 1:7 to 1:10+ R/R with a hard 3-Strike Invalidation rule.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Implement MicroMapStateMachine with 3-strike lock, Inside Bar trigger, H2/H3 confirmations, and Doji SL spread buffer.

nodes.concept_name: Time Analysis Strategy (11 Graded Windows & 9 Master Time Points)
nodes.detailed_description: Vertical-axis temporal analysis weighting price action across 11 graded Time Windows (A, B, C) and 9 Master Time Points (03:00, 04:00, 08:00, 09:00, 10:00, 16:30, 18:00, 20:00, 23:00 GMT+3) with symbol-specific schedules for XAUUSD, US30, and EURUSD.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Implement TimeStrategyEngine with GMT+3 normalization, symbol window tables, and 5-minute pre-Time-Point warning.

nodes.concept_name: Horizontal Memory Levels (Weekly Map 13 Levels, PDH/PDL, Session HL, Round Levels)
nodes.detailed_description: Time-derived horizontal support/resistance framework: Weekly Map (13 levels in 25% steps from -2x to +2x + Weekend Gap), PDH/PDL/Mid/Open/Close, US30 16:30-23:00 NY Session HL, and 0.5% auto-step Round Levels.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Implement WeeklyMapIndicator, PreviousDaySessionLevels (M15 scan), and RoundLevelsIndicator.

nodes.concept_name: 3-Witness Signal Prioritization Triad (Time + Level + Price Action)
nodes.detailed_description: Ranks every candidate setup by the confluence of Witness 1 (Time Window/Point), Witness 2 (Horizontal Memory Level), and Witness 3 (SP2L/PRO BTB/MicroMap trigger), eliminating FOMO.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Score candidate signals 0..3; require valid Price Action trigger for all trades; allocate maximum risk to Tier-1 (3/3) setups.

nodes.concept_name: Map Manager Expert Advisor (v2.0.1) & 10% Risk Cap
nodes.detailed_description: 15-control on-chart MT4/MT5 trade & risk manager computing dynamic lot size from SL distance, enforcing a 10% total risk cap, and providing 1-click Risk Free (with spread), Half Close, Chart Close, and Full Close.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Implement Poursamadi_MapManager.mq5 and Python risk-sizing / 10%-cap gatekeeper.

nodes.concept_name: Half-Close Insurance Formula (2R/3R) & 180s Broker Hold-Time Guard
nodes.detailed_description: Closing 50% volume at 2R/3R mathematically guarantees net profit (+0.5R to +1.0R) while keeping original SL intact; 180s minimum hold-time guard prevents broker latency-arbitrage profit confiscation on M1.

nodes.concept_name: Session Windows Pro (v3.0) & Session Clock Pro (v1.0) Indicators
nodes.detailed_description: Visual MT4/MT5 indicators rendering the 11 graded windows, 9 Time Points, and live 5-minute countdown panel across 7 Teaching Views (`Full map`, `Main sessions`, etc.) with automatic or manual DST/UTC broker alignment.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Configure Broker setup (Supported broker or Other broker -> UTC+02:00 + Europe/USA/No clock change).

nodes.concept_name: Exhaustion Gap, 1-2-3 MTR Reversal & NY Close Magnet Strategy
nodes.detailed_description: Reversal architecture when a late-window Exhaustion Gap or 3-push Wedge (MTR) hits Weekly Map 2.0x or Range Ceiling and forms a PRO BTB / Pin Bar rejection targeting the 50% range midpoint or Previous NY Close.
nodes.practical_implementation_requirements: Detect 3-push wedge + breakdown + BTB Doji/Pin Bar retest; project TP to NY Close or 50% range.

edges.note: Rational execution requires dollar risk <= psychological tolerance ceiling.
Mandatory EOD close implements horizon rationality and prevents 90% of margin calls.
SP2L requires candle-by-candle counting and a valid P-Gap inside the Spike.
PRO BTB extends SP2L to post-breakout Breakeven retests with tighter SL and 6 entry modes.
Nesting MicroMap inside an SP2L pullback compresses SL to 1 candle, boosting R/R from 1:2 to 1:10.
MicroMap Entry 1/2/3 and H2/H3 confirmations serve as precision triggers on PRO BTB levels.
Weekly Map, PDH/PDL, and US30 Session HL (16:30-23:00) are mathematical derivatives of time boundaries.
Session Windows Pro v3.0 and Session Clock Pro v1.0 visually implement the Time Strategy schedule.
Witness 1 of the Signal Triad is Time (Active Window & Time Point).
Witness 2 of the Signal Triad is Level (Weekly Map / PDH-PDL / Session HL / Round Level).
Witness 3 of the Signal Triad is the Price Action trigger (SP2L / PRO BTB / MicroMap).
Map Manager enforces automatic risk sizing, 10% total risk cap, and removes Martingale x2 buttons.
Uses Map Manager Half Close at 2R/3R for self-insurance and enforces the 180s anti-arbitrage hold timer.
At outer 2.0x Weekly Map / Range Ceiling late in a window, Exhaustion Gap / MTR overrides SP2L continuation.
Verified by 32 random RNG trades in Video 06 and 3-day +50% live growth in Video 02.
